scenario_config.prompt:
I need to reorganize my mailbox so that I can manage travel plans and team coordination more efficiently. Please introduce two new labels: one for all my upcoming travel arrangements and another for team communication that needs my attention. Any new message that includes travel-related terms in the subject, like booking confirmations, flight schedules, itinerary updates, hotel reservations, or trip changes, should be grouped under the travel label while still staying in my inbox. Messages from my team or with subjects mentioning standups, project updates, approvals, or discussions should go under the team attention label without removing them from the inbox.

Move low-value routine updates, such as automated platform summaries or digest emails, out of my inbox and store them under a low-priority updates label, marking them as read. If there are any old filters that send important team messages to the wrong place or archive travel information, fix those so everything lines up with this structure.

Also, activate a safe auto-reply for when I’m traveling. It should only respond to direct human senders, not automated systems or mailing lists. Keep my IMAP settings as they are, but restrict POP access so nothing can drain the mailbox while I'm away.

verifier_configs.name: label_travel_created
verifier_configs.description: Ensures a label for travel-related messages exists.
verifier_configs.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM labels
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%travel%'
  AND (LOWER(name) LIKE '%arrange%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%plan%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%trip%');

verifier_configs.name: label_team_attention_created
verifier_configs.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM labels
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%team%'
  AND (LOWER(name) LIKE '%attention%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%action%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%review%');

verifier_configs.name: label_low_priority_updates_created
verifier_configs.description: Confirms a label for low-priority automated summaries exists.
verifier_configs.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM labels
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%low%'
  AND LOWER(name) LIKE '%update%';

verifier_configs.name: filter_travel_created
verifier_configs.description: Ensures there is at least one travel-related filter.
verifier_configs.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM filters
WHERE criteria_json LIKE '%booking%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%flight%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%itinerary%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%hotel%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%reservation%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%trip%';

verifier_configs.name: filter_team_created
verifier_configs.description: Validates the existence of a filter for team-attention messages.
verifier_configs.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM filters
WHERE criteria_json LIKE '%standup%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%approval%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%discussion%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%project%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%team%';

verifier_configs.name: filter_low_priority_created
verifier_configs.description: Checks that a filter exists for low-priority automated updates.
verifier_configs.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM filters
WHERE criteria_json LIKE '%digest%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%summary%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%automated%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%noreply%'
   OR criteria_json LIKE '%no-reply%';

verifier_configs.name: no_travel_skip_conflict
verifier_configs.description: Ensures travel messages are not mistakenly archived/removed from inbox.
verifier_configs.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM filters
WHERE (criteria_json LIKE '%booking%' OR criteria_json LIKE '%flight%' OR criteria_json LIKE '%trip%')
  AND action_json LIKE '%skipInbox%';

verifier_configs.name: no_team_skip_conflict
verifier_configs.description: Ensures team messages are not mistakenly hidden or archived.
verifier_configs.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM filters
WHERE (criteria_json LIKE '%team%' OR criteria_json LIKE '%standup%' OR criteria_json LIKE '%approval%' OR criteria_json LIKE '%discussion%')
  AND action_json LIKE '%skipInbox%';

verifier_configs.name: vacation_responder_safe_mode_enabled
verifier_configs.description: Confirms auto-reply only goes to humans (not bots or mailing lists).
verifier_configs.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM vacation_settings
WHERE restrict_to_contacts = 1
   OR restrict_to_domain = 1;

verifier_configs.name: pop_restricted
verifier_configs.description: Verifies POP cannot drain or expose full mailbox during travel.
